title: Alternative Pathways for Students Required to Leave School Before Completing National Certifications
what_it_is: Alternative Pathways for Students Required to Leave School Before Completing National Certifications

sections.label: Alternative pathways for school leavers
sections.summary: MOE provides re-admission, bridging programmes, ITE General Education and SkillsFuture training for students leaving school before completing national certifications.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education in respect of students who are required to leave school before completing their national certifications, what alternative education, training or reintegration pathways does the Ministry provide to ensure they are not left without viable progression options.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: And those who wish to continue their education may approach the school in which they were last enrolled.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Alternatively, they can approach the Ministry of Education's Education and Career Guidance Centre for advice and guidance on suitable educational pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: If they are assessed to be age-appropriate for re-admission, they can be enrolled at a secondary school.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The receiving schools may assess these students and provide bridging programmes to smoothen their transition back into mainstream education.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: While for students who prefer other education and training options, there are also alternative pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: So, students with minimal academic qualifications can consider the Institute of Technical Education General Education programme, which allows adult learners to obtain their GCE "N" or "O" Levels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This, in turn, then allows them to subsequently enrol in Higher Nitec and Diploma programmes in our institutes of higher learning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr David Neo) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SkillsFuture Singapore also provides subsidies for a wide range of industry-relevant training programmes to meet the upskilling needs of Singaporeans throughout their careers, regardless of their education or academic qualifications.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: To the Member's question about tracking outcomes, today, MOE tracks outcomes of students.
